sections.Profile:
"Kicker," released by Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co. in August 1966, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine with a soccer theme. Designed by Jerry Koci, it features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, two kick-out holes, and three messenger balls. The backglass includes light animation depicting a player kicking a ball, enhancing the thematic experience.
